requirement_text.REQ-432:
Follow-on to REQ-373 (service_catalog version/status lifecycle + real PinResolver.Lookup, status: done on the backend) and to REQ-399 (case-detail dependency-version/provenance screen, status: done -- REQ-399 already built the GET /api/v1/instances/{id}/pins route, web/src/hooks/useInstancePins.ts, and web/src/components/instances/InstancePinsPanel.tsx, wired into InstanceDetailPage.tsx). Filed from ISS-0898, split from ISS-0890's WF05-FULL-20260929 PLATFORM UAT report: the platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change scenario (test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/platform/instance-pin-survives-catalog-change.yaml) is BLOCKED not because the read-only provenance screen is missing (REQ-399 built that) but because two operator ACTIONS the scenario's own steps exercise have no UI anywhere, and REQ-399's own SCOPE explicitly excluded one of them: "any UI affordance to CHANGE a pin from this screen... is a separate requirement if one is ever filed."
WHAT EXISTS TODAY, verified 2026-09-30 by direct source read: - `POST /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id/versions` (publish) and
  `POST /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id/retire` (retire) are real,
  shipped REQ-373 routes (lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex,
  design doc lib/letflow/design/req373-service-catalog-version-lifecycle.md
  §7), gated by the existing :AdminServicesManage permission. Grepping
  web/src/api/services.ts and web/src/pages/admin/services/ServicesPage.tsx
  for "publish"/"retire"/"version" returns zero hits beyond the existing
  `ServiceRecord` type -- neither route has any frontend client function or
  UI control. An operator today cannot publish a new service-connection
  version or retire an old one from the GUI at all, which is exactly the
  scenario's own step 2 action.
- `POST /instances/:id/rebind-pins` is a real, shipped REQ-078/PIN-05 route
  (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex, `Letflow.Engine.PinRebind.rebind_pins/3`,
  200 response `{instance_id, changes, rebound_at}`, each change item
  carrying `ref`/`prior_version`/`new_version` per the
  `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND` event it appends). Grepping web/src for "rebind"
  returns zero hits beyond REQ-399's own read-only provenance panel and its
  test -- there is no rebind client function, no rebind action/button/dialog
  anywhere in web/src. An operator today cannot deliberately move a running
  case onto a different pinned version from the GUI at all, which is
  exactly the scenario's own step 5 action (with a caller-supplied reason
  -- `rebind_attrs()` requires `:idempotency_key`, per
  lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex's own design notes, and the scenario's
  step 5 input is `reason: \"External system retires the old endpoint at
  month end.\"`).
- Case history rendering: grepped web/src for any existing generic
  event-timeline renderer capable of showing an `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND`
  entry with actor/prior_version/new_version/reason (EO-005's own evidence
  requirement, "the case history shows the change with the operator's
  name, the previous and new version, and the reason given") -- confirm at
  implementation time whether InstanceDetailPage.tsx's existing
  history/timeline section already renders arbitrary event types generically
  (in which case this requirement only needs the rebind action itself to
  produce the right event, already true by construction since
  `rebind_pins/3` already appends the real event) or needs a
  dedicated case for this event type -- do not assume either way without
  checking.

THIS REQUIREMENT BUILDS: (1) a typed `publish`/`retire` client pair in web/src/api/services.ts and UI controls on web/src/pages/admin/services/ServicesPage.tsx (a "publish new version" action taking the publish_attrs() fields plus a version string, and a "retire" action) for a PLATFORM_ADMIN-equivalent operator; (2) a typed `rebind` client function (POST /instances/:id/rebind-pins) and a rebind action/dialog on REQ-399's InstancePinsPanel.tsx (or InstanceDetailPage.tsx) requiring the caller to supply a reason string, wired to the real endpoint; (3) confirm, and if needed extend, the case history/timeline rendering so an `INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND` entry's actor, prior_version, new_version and reason are all visible per EO-005; (4) the named pipeline_test spec.
OUT OF SCOPE: any change to `Letflow.ServiceCatalog`, `PinResolver`, `PinRebind`, or any of REQ-373/REQ-399's already-shipped routes (pure frontend consumption/action wiring against already-shipped endpoints); re-scoping or modifying REQ-399's read-only provenance display beyond what is needed to add the rebind action to the same screen; PLC-01/module_ref catalog versioning (still the identical, already-named SCOPE GAP pin_resolver.ex's own moduledoc states, unscoped to any stage, restated by both REQ-373 and REQ-399).

task.description: WF-02 Step 5 (release validation) for REQ-432. Verify branch feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930. INDEPENDENTLY RE-DERIVE, do not trust the TEST-RUNNER reports. (1) Run the full backend suite yourself with scripts/test_parallel.sh (use TEST_PARALLEL_N=6: the default N=nproc=16 measurably aborts partitions on a 15s tenant-template DB timeout on this host, see test/reports/report-20260930-WF02-REQ432-20260930.yaml and the step-04 handoff, which is a host/infra effect and not a REQ-432 defect); quote the combined Result:/Failed: counts; attribute every failure structurally per core-directives.md 'Failure Attribution Is Structural, Never By Count-Matching' (this diff has NO Elixir lib/test/config/priv change: verify with git diff --name-only main...HEAD -- lib test/letflow test/support config priv mix.exs mix.lock, which should list only lib/letflow/design/req432-*.md), and remember your re-run will not reproduce the predecessor's failure set exactly; an unattributable failure is UNATTRIBUTED and reported for filing, it does not get folded into a known set; also make sure no orphan erl.exe processes remain afterwards. (2) From web/ run npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run guards and quote counts. (3) Run the pipeline spec live once yourself (recipe: step-02b-frontend-dev.json result.issues[0] and step-04-rerun1-test-runner.json; backend LETFLOW_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY from ./.env, LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED=1 MIX_ENV=dev mix run --no-halt on this checkout's own Postgres 5482, started by a foreground script you wait on with a trap that stops it; then cd web && BPM_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4000 BPM_IDP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8094 VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4000 npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts). If the host's Keycloak is unreachable at that moment, say so and rely on the TEST-RUNNER's two live runs as cited-but-not-independently-reproduced evidence. Stop everything you start; verify no orphans. (4) Confirm EVERY acceptance criterion of REQ-432 explicitly against the actual code/tests (read the REQ-432 entry in docs/requirements.yaml with a TARGETED read only: Grep -n 'id: REQ-432' then Read offset/limit; nine criteria), criterion by criterion, with file evidence, not TEST-RUNNER's summary. KNOWN OPEN POINT you must rule on explicitly: acceptance criterion 'retiring a version does not error or block the already-running case's own pin display or its in-flight step' -- the PIN DISPLAY half is proven (unit + live pipeline steps 03/04), but the live run shows the in-flight service step ends in EXECUTION_ERROR (HTTP 500 on POST /tasks/:id/complete, node n3, service_task_url_rendered_empty) regardless of retirement because Letflow.Engine.ServiceTaskDispatcher's catalog lookup is still an unconditional stub ({:error,:not_registered}); this backend gap is OUT OF REQ-432's scope fence (REQ-432 forbids touching the engine/pin code and is frontend-only) and will be forwarded as its own issue. State whether the requirement can be marked done with this half of the AC documented as unverifiable-on-success-because-of-an-independent-backend-gap, or must instead be PARTIAL/FAIL; reason from the requirement text and the acceptance criterion's wording, and give a clear recommendation in result.summary (the decision between done-with-forwarded-issue and not-done belongs to ORCH, who will follow your reasoned ruling). Also check the forward-looking honesty: test/specs/REQ-432.md has two known stale-text MINORs (says 39 tests, measured 36; AC1 section still says 'NOT run green') -- DOC-UPDATER will correct them at Step 6, you only confirm. (5) Check docs/status/requirement_status*.yaml and docs/requirements.yaml for staleness relative to what shipped (REQ-432 is currently in_progress; ORCH flipped it at Step 00 with a started event in requirement_status.v25.yaml; the done flip is DOC-UPDATER's Step 6). (6) Write your release decision record if your role file prescribes one (docs/status/ naming per release-validator.md), commit it by explicit filename, push to origin feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930. Lint your handoff: mix letflow.lint_handoffs --dir handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-05-release-validator.json. Claim by setting status IN_PROGRESS only; on finish set COMPLETED/FAILED, result.status one of PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/BLOCKED/SKIPPED, real-clock completed_at; never edit task/created_at/started_at; do not write registry.json.

result.summary: PASS (conditional, see ruling). Independent re-derivation: (1) backend full suite re-run by me with scripts/test_parallel.sh TEST_PARALLEL_N=6, executed as 4 path-partitioned chunks because one foreground call cannot outlast the 10 min tool cap: engine 1146 tests+1 property, routers/api/plugs 1209, rest-part-1 1491, rest-part-2 1225+7 properties = 5071 tests, 8 properties, 0 failures (5079/5079), identical to TEST-RUNNER combined count. Then mix letflow.check.test with TEST_PARALLEL_N=6: "mix letflow.check.test: OK" (partitions 851/972/712/899/917/720 tests; combined: 5071 tests, 8 properties, 0 failures (5079/5079 passed)). Structural scope: git diff --name-only main...HEAD -- lib test/letflow test/support config priv mix.exs mix.lock lists only lib/letflow/design/req432-rebind-pins-publish-retire-ui.md (a design doc), so no failure could be attributable to REQ-432 code. Infra/unattributed events, reported not folded: (a) unmodified mix letflow.check.test (N=nproc=16) aborted on DBConnection 15s timeout at test/support/tenant_template.ex:181 (same host effect as step-04); (b) two runs (first full-suite attempt and rest-part-1 attempt 1) had 5-6 partition BEAMs die simultaneously with no error text and script exit 127/1; UNATTRIBUTED (no test or lib code contains taskkill/kill; identical re-runs passed clean), treated as host interference, worth filing. (2) web: type-check clean, lint clean (max-warnings 0), npm test 150 files/995 tests passed, guards 4 files/52 tests passed. (3) pipeline spec live by me: attempts 1 and 2 failed at assertServiceReadiness (Keycloak discovery fetch ECONNRESET from Playwright node; localhost:8094 flaky on this host though curl 127.0.0.1 gave 200); attempt 3 with the exact recipe: 1 passed (8.7s), step 3 outcome B logged. Backend stopped via trap; no listener on 4000/4173 and no erl/beam/chrome/node process afterwards. (4) All nine ACs checked with file evidence, see issues[]. RULING on AC7 in-flight half: mark REQ-432 DONE with that half documented as unverifiable-on-success and an independent backend issue forwarded; not PARTIAL/FAIL. Reasons: (i) the requirement own fence (AC8 plus OUT OF SCOPE) forbids the only change that could make it demonstrable (catalog_lookup_stub/2 in lib/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher.ex returns {:error,:not_registered} unconditionally); (ii) AC wording is retiring does not error or block: the observed failure is causally independent of retirement (stub ignores catalog state) and is pinned by the spec to exactly n3/service_task_url_rendered_empty with no TASK_COMPLETED(n2); (iii) the pin-display half is proven by a mutation-verified unit test and live. Honesty conditions: do not record AC7 as fully met; the done status event must say the in-flight half is not demonstrated on success; the backend dispatcher/catalog-lookup follow-on must be filed (REQ-ANALYST) at flip time. Residual weakness: the spec has no paired control run showing outcome B identical without retirement; causal independence rests on reading the stub. Stale-text MINORs confirmed still present in test/specs/REQ-432.md: says 39 tests (line 19; TEST-RUNNER measured 36) and AC1 section (line 53) says NOT run green although the honesty statement says it ran green (DOC-UPDATER Step 6). Docs: requirements.yaml REQ-432 is in_progress and requirement_status.v25.yaml has the started event only; no staleness beyond the pending done flip. No decision record contradicted (no Elixir change). release-validator.md prescribes no decision-record file; none written.
